The dish is mounted on a complex steel support structure (alt-azimuth mount) and faces upwards. A wooden boardwalk leads towards the base of the telescope in the foreground.

The thin struts holding the central sub-reflector appear somewhat indistinct and blend slightly into the bright sky background. Their connection points to the main dish rim are not sharply defined, suggesting minor generation ambiguity.

The wooden boardwalk in the foreground has very straight, parallel lines that converge perfectly but lack the slight irregularities (warping wood, uneven planks) expected in a real outdoor structure, appearing slightly too geometrically perfect.
